name: hcapp_addKennelPhoto
description: Records a kennel photo after the app has uploaded the image blob to Azure Storage. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 31, standard token); no permission gate to ADD (any hasher may photograph a run), but the resolved status depends on roles. Validation: @photoId, @eventId, @kennelId and @blobUrl required (1231, errorType 12); the event must belong to @kennelId (1331, 13). Effective sharing preference, most specific first: @perRunSharingOverride → HasherKennelMap.PhotoSharingPreference (> 0) → Hasher.Preferences bit 0x40. Status written: 0 private when not shared; when shared, 3 public if the caller holds the 'editPhoto' capability (HC6.CheckKennelPermission — Hash Flash / GM / VGM / RA, who could approve it anyway, 2026-08-25) else 1 pending review. The INSERT is idempotent on the client-generated @photoId (INSERT … WHERE NOT EXISTS with UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, 2026-07-11): a retry of the same photo returns success with the same id and the newly computed status, inserting nothing. No sync delegation — photos are fetched on demand by hcapp_getRunPhotos. A quota stub (@maxPhotosPerUserPerRun) is present but NULL.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to HC6.ValidateAppAuth for auth resolution.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived auth token validated against DeviceSecret.

parameters.name: photoId
parameters.description: Client-generated GUID for the photo row. Must be unique. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error (errorCode 1231, errorType 12).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: Event the photo belongs to. Must exist and belong to @kennelId. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel scope. Must match the event's KennelId. Null or zero-UUID triggers a validation error.

parameters.name: blobUrl
parameters.description: Full CDN URL to the uploaded blob. Required; empty string triggers a validation error.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude where the photo was taken.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude where the photo was taken.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional short title for the photo. Defaults to NULL.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Optional longer caption/description. Defaults to NULL.

parameters.name: assetId
parameters.description: Device-library identifier (iOS PHAsset.localIdentifier / Android MediaStore URI). NULL when the user had 'save to camera roll' disabled or permission denied. Device-specific — only valid on the device that uploaded the photo. Defaults to NULL.

parameters.name: takenAtUtc
parameters.description: When the photo was taken (UTC), as distinct from CreatedAt which is when it was uploaded. NULL when the client cannot tell — never inferred from the upload time.

parameters.name: perRunSharingOverride
parameters.description: Per-run sharing override. NULL (default) = resolve from saved preferences; 0 = keep private; 1 = share (status 1 pending review, or 3 public for 'editPhoto' holders). CAST to TINYINT, so a value outside 0-255 is an arithmetic overflow caught by the CATCH.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: Standard success/failure envelope. On auth failure or validation error: success=0, errorCode and errorType set. On DB error: success=0, errorCode=1931, errorType=19. On success: success=1, errorCode=NULL, errorType=NULL. Mutually exclusive position with error detail rowset at index 1.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Numeric error code. NULL on success.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification code. NULL on success.

rowsets.name: PhotoResult
rowsets.description: On success: the inserted photo ID and resolved initial status. On error: standard HC6 error detail rowset. These two shapes are mutually exclusive at index 1.

columns.name: status
columns.description: Resolved initial status: 0 private, 1 pending review, 3 public (shared photo from an 'editPhoto' holder). On an idempotent re-submit this is the freshly computed value, which may differ from what the existing row holds.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.KennelPhotos (id, EventId, KennelId, UserId, BlobUrl, AssetId, Latitude, Longitude, Status, Title, Description, TakenAtUtc) WHERE NOT EXISTS (same id, UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK) — inside a transaction; a duplicate inserts nothing and still succeeds.
EXEC HC6.CheckKennelPermission 'editPhoto' when the photo is shared, to decide auto-approval.
Reads Hasher.Preferences (bit 0x40) and HasherKennelMap.PhotoSharingPreference to resolve the sharing preference when @perRunSharingOverride is NULL.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on 1231, 1331 (pre-flight) and in the CATCH (1931).

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken, @photoId, @eventId, @kennelId, @blobUrl, @latitude, @longitude (lines 3-10) have no SQL default. A client that omits any of them is refused by SQL BEFORE the procedure runs: no HC.ErrorLog row, an empty 500 in the app, and the SP's own graceful checks are unreachable (CLAUDE.md, Rack of Lamb 2026-09-29). The graceful 1231 checks at lines 101-129 cover NULL values only, not omission.
@maxPhotosPerUserPerRun is hardcoded to NULL, making the entire quota check block dead code until paid tiers are designed. Noted in the SP header as intentional (v2 placeholder).

codeSmells.issue: Validation for eventId/kennelId/blobUrl combined in one block
codeSmells.detail: Lines 115-129: one error block (1231) covers eventId, kennelId and blobUrl, and line 101 uses the same 1231 for photoId. The caller cannot tell which parameter was missing from the code; only ErrorLog.ErrorName differs.

codeSmells.issue: Idempotent re-submit returns a status that may not match the stored row
codeSmells.detail: Lines 226-236: when the row already exists nothing is written, but the reply echoes the status computed on THIS call. If the sharing preference or the caller's roles changed between the two submits the client is told a status the server does not hold.
The column written at line 227 was added by a later archive script; the schema snapshot is stale.

breakingChanges: New SP — no HC5 predecessor. No breaking changes from migration.
